card.name: Digits in dates and temperatures
card.fires_on: A single digit in a two-digit number, usually the day in a calendar date (e.g. 'Monday, 21 May 2007') or the start of a room-temperature value in °C. It also fires on a leading digit in a speed range.

modes.description: A digit of the day number in a weekday-and-month date line.
